name: data_component_tool
description: Data Tool - Component tool to perform actions like get and query components, create blank components, transform elements into components, insert and unlink component instances, manage component props and variants, and more.

siteId.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site (e.g., '580e63e98c9a982ac9b8b741'). Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

pageId.description: Any valid page id exists in the site

label.description: Label echoed in the response for this action item. It does not select which action runs.

name.description: The name of the blank component to create.

group.description: Optional group/folder to place the component in.

create_blank_component.description: Create a blank component with no root element. Equivalent to 'Create blank' in the Designer's New Component menu.

anyOf.description: Run create_blank_component: Create a blank component with no root element. Equivalent to 'Create blank' in the Designer's New Component menu.

component_id.description: The id of the component to add props to.

name.description: The display name of the prop.

open_in_new_tab.description: Open the link in a new tab.

items.description: Per-type settings live in the matching default_* group. Image / id / altText / textContent props don't take a default group beyond `default_text` when applicable.

props.description: Props to create. Validation is all-or-nothing — if any prop fails the schema or buildCreatePropOptions checks, no props are created. Runtime API creation is sequential and stops on the first failure: props already created before the failure remain on the component.

create_prop.description: Create one or more new prop definitions on a component. Validation is all-or-nothing — if any prop fails the schema, no props are created. Runtime creation is sequential and stops on the first API failure; props already created before the failure remain on the component.

anyOf.description: Run create_prop: Create one or more new prop definitions on a component. Validation is all-or-nothing — if any prop fails the schema, no props are created. Runtime creation is sequential and stops on the first API failure; props already created before the failure remain on the component.

name.description: The name for the new variant.

create_variant.description: Create a new variant on a component with a specified name.

anyOf.description: Run create_variant: Create a new variant on a component with a specified name.

variant_id.description: The id of the variant to delete.

delete_variant.description: Delete a variant from a component by ID. The base variant cannot be deleted.

anyOf.description: Run delete_variant: Delete a variant from a component by ID. The base variant cannot be deleted.

source_component_id.description: The id of the source component to duplicate.

name.description: The name for the duplicated component.

group.description: Optional group for the duplicated component.

description.description: Optional description for the duplicated component.

duplicate_component.description: Duplicate an existing component with a new name. Copies the component structure from the source component.

anyOf.description: Run duplicate_component: Duplicate an existing component with a new name. Copies the component structure from the source component.

source_variant_id.description: The id of the source variant to duplicate.

name.description: Optional name for the new variant.

duplicate_variant.description: Duplicate an existing variant on a component. Copies settings and styles from the source variant.

anyOf.description: Run duplicate_variant: Duplicate an existing variant on a component. Copies settings and styles from the source variant.

includeProps.description: When true, include component prop definitions.

includeInstanceCount.description: When true, include the instance count for the component.

includeVariants.description: When true, include all variant definitions.

includeVariant.description: When provided, include the variant with this ID. Use 'base' for the base variant.

includeSelectedVariant.description: When true, include the currently selected variant.

filterProps.description: Filter which props to include. Fields are ANDed together; values within a field are ORed.

options.description: Options to control what is included in the response.

get_all_components.description: Get all components in the site. Returns an array of ComponentInfo, with optional props, variants, and instance counts.

anyOf.description: Run get_all_components: Get all components in the site. Returns an array of ComponentInfo, with optional props, variants, and instance counts.

component_id.description: The id of the component to get. Use this or name.

name.description: The name of the component. Use this or component_id.

group.description: Optional group to narrow the search when using name.

includeProps.description: When true, include component prop definitions.

includeInstanceCount.description: When true, include the instance count for the component.

includeVariants.description: When true, include all variant definitions.

includeVariant.description: When provided, include the variant with this ID. Use 'base' for the base variant.

includeSelectedVariant.description: When true, include the currently selected variant.

filterProps.description: Filter which props to include. Fields are ANDed together; values within a field are ORed.

options.description: Options to control what is included in the response.

get_component.description: Get a component by ID or by name. Provide component_id for ID lookup, or name (and optional group) for name lookup.

anyOf.description: Run get_component: Get a component by ID or by name. Provide component_id for ID lookup, or name (and optional group) for name lookup.

component.description: The component id portion of an element id pair.

element.description: The element id portion of an element id pair.

element_id.description: Element id of the component instance whose props to read.

resolved_value.description: When true, bindings are resolved to concrete values rather than returned as binding references.

scope_component_id.description: Optional id of the component definition the element lives inside. When set, the element lookup walks this component's tree instead of the page. When omitted, the page is searched first and then the component id portion of the element id is tried automatically.

get_component_instance_props.description: Get all prop definitions and their current values for a component instance element. Instances nested inside component definitions are supported.

anyOf.description: Run get_component_instance_props: Get all prop definitions and their current values for a component instance element. Instances nested inside component definitions are supported.

component.description: The component id portion of an element id pair.

element.description: The element id portion of an element id pair.

id.description: Element id whose enclosing component to find.

scope_component_id.description: Optional id of the component definition the element lives inside. When set, the element lookup walks this component's tree instead of the page. When omitted, the page is searched first and then the component id portion of the element id is tried automatically.

get_parent_component.description: Get the component that contains the specified element. Returns { found: null } when the element is at page level. Elements nested inside component definitions are supported.

anyOf.description: Run get_parent_component: Get the component that contains the specified element. Returns { found: null } when the element is at page level. Elements nested inside component definitions are supported.

get_variant_settings.description: Get the settings (id, name, selection state) of a specific variant on a component.

anyOf.description: Run get_variant_settings: Get the settings (id, name, selection state) of a specific variant on a component.

style_name.description: The name of the style to read.

get_variant_styles.description: Get the styles applied to a specific variant on a component. Returns properties scoped to the variant, independent of the base component styles.

anyOf.description: Run get_variant_styles: Get the styles applied to a specific variant on a component. Returns properties scoped to the variant, independent of the base component styles.

component.description: The component id portion of an element id pair.

element.description: The element id portion of an element id pair.

parent_element_id.description: Parent element id to insert under or beside.

component_id.description: The id of the component to insert.

creation_position.description: Where to place the new instance. append/prepend insert as child; before/after insert as sibling.

scope_component_id.description: Optional id of the component definition the element lives inside. When set, the element lookup walks this component's tree instead of the page. When omitted, the page is searched first and then the component id portion of the element id is tried automatically.

insert_component_instance.description: Insert a component instance on the current active page. Parent elements nested inside component definitions are supported.

anyOf.description: Run insert_component_instance: Insert a component instance on the current active page. Parent elements nested inside component definitions are supported.

label.description: A label to identify this query in the results.

keywords.description: Search keywords. Each keyword is matched case-insensitively as a substring against component name, group, and description. All keywords must match (AND).

hasProps.description: When true, only return components that have props. When false, only return components without props.

propsFilter.description: Filter to components that have at least one prop matching these criteria.

includeProps.description: When true, include component prop definitions.

includeInstanceCount.description: When true, include the instance count for the component.

includeVariants.description: When true, include all variant definitions.

includeVariant.description: When provided, include the variant with this ID. Use 'base' for the base variant.

includeSelectedVariant.description: When true, include the currently selected variant.

filterProps.description: Filter which props to include. Fields are ANDed together; values within a field are ORed.

resultOptions.description: Options to control what is included in the response.

isLibrary.description: When true, only return library components (those imported from an installed library). When false, exclude library components.

isCodeComponent.description: When true, only return code components (DevLink, Site AI, Library AI). When false, exclude code components.

limit.description: Max results for this query. Default: 50, Max: 200.

queries.description: Labelled queries to execute in a single call.

query_components.description: Query components with filtering by keywords, prop characteristics, and more. Supports multiple labelled queries per call.

anyOf.description: Run query_components: Query components with filtering by keywords, prop characteristics, and more. Supports multiple labelled queries per call.

prop_ids.description: Ids of the props to remove.

remove_prop.description: Remove one or more prop definitions from a component. Each prop is removed independently; per-prop errors are aggregated.

anyOf.description: Run remove_prop: Remove one or more prop definitions from a component. Each prop is removed independently; per-prop errors are aggregated.

variant_ids.description: Ordered list of variant ids (including 'base'). Partial lists reorder the listed variants as a block anchored at the first listed variant's current position; unlisted variants keep their relative order. The response echoes the input list, not the resulting order — pass the full list for a deterministic total order.

reorder_variants.description: Reorder the variants of a component. Pass an ordered list of variant IDs (including 'base').

anyOf.description: Run reorder_variants: Reorder the variants of a component. Pass an ordered list of variant IDs (including 'base').

component.description: The component id portion of an element id pair.

element.description: The element id portion of an element id pair.

element_id.description: Element id of the component instance to reset.

scope_component_id.description: Optional id of the component definition the element lives inside. When set, the element lookup walks this component's tree instead of the page. When omitted, the page is searched first and then the component id portion of the element id is tried automatically.

reset_all_props_value.description: Reset all prop values on a component instance element back to their defaults. Instances nested inside component definitions are supported.

anyOf.description: Run reset_all_props_value: Reset all prop values on a component instance element back to their defaults. Instances nested inside component definitions are supported.

component.description: Component-scope ID. Pass the value of element.id.component verbatim — do not invent or shorten it.

element.description: Element ID within the component scope. Pass the value of element.id.element verbatim — do not invent or shorten it.

element_id.description: Composite Designer element identifier. Always a two-field object — never a single string. Copy the `id` field verbatim from any Designer element returned by de_component_tool (get_all_components, get_component, get_current_component, get_parent_component) or element_tool (get_selected_element, query_elements, get_all_elements). Example: { component: "abc123", element: "def456" }.

type.description: The type of value to set.

string_value.description: The string value. Required when type is "string".

number_value.description: The number value. Required when type is "number".

boolean_value.description: The boolean value. Required when type is "boolean".

link_mode.description: The link mode. Required when type is "link".

link_to.description: The link target. For url/email/phone: the literal value. For page: pageId. For file: assetId. For collectionPage: pageSlug. For pageSection: elementId.

link_to_component_id.description: The component ID of the target element. Only used when link_mode is "pageSection".

link_open_in_new_tab.description: Whether the link opens in a new tab.

link_email_subject.description: The email subject. Only used when link_mode is email.

link_rel.description: The rel attribute for the link.

video_src.description: The video source URL. Required when type is "video".

binding_source_type.description: The binding source type. Required when type is "bindable".

binding_prop_id.description: The prop ID to bind to. Required when binding_source_type is "prop".

binding_collection_id.description: The CMS collection ID. Required when binding_source_type is "cms".

binding_field_id.description: The CMS field ID. Required when binding_source_type is "cms".

binding_field_key.description: The field key. Required when binding_source_type is "page", "locale", or "localeItem".

rich_text_inner_text.description: Rich-text inner content. Required when type is "richText".

scope_component_id.description: Optional id of the component definition the element lives inside. When set, the element lookup walks this component's tree instead of the page. When omitted, the page is searched first and then the component id portion of the element id is tried automatically.

set_component_instance_prop_values.description: Set prop values on a component instance element. Instances nested inside component definitions are supported. Supports `prop`, `cms`, `page`, `locale`, and `localeItem` bindings — `cms` requires the instance to be in a CMS context (collection template page or Collection List); `locale` requires the site to have secondary locales.

anyOf.description: Run set_component_instance_prop_values: Set prop values on a component instance element. Instances nested inside component definitions are supported. Supports `prop`, `cms`, `page`, `locale`, and `localeItem` bindings — `cms` requires the instance to be in a CMS context (collection template page or Collection List); `locale` requires the site to have secondary locales.

set_component_metadata.description: Update metadata (name, group, description) of a component.

anyOf.description: Run set_component_metadata: Update metadata (name, group, description) of a component.

variant_id.description: The id of the variant. Use 'base' to rename the base variant.

set_variant_name.description: Update the name of a variant on a component. Use 'base' as variant_id to rename the base variant.

anyOf.description: Run set_variant_name: Update the name of a variant on a component. Use 'base' as variant_id to rename the base variant.

variable_as_value.description: Variable id to use as the value.

remove_properties.description: Properties to remove from the variant style.

set_variant_styles.description: Set or update styles on a specific variant. Style changes are scoped to the variant and do not affect the base component or other variants.

anyOf.description: Run set_variant_styles: Set or update styles on a specific variant. Style changes are scoped to the variant and do not affect the base component or other variants.

component.description: The component id portion of an element id pair.

element.description: The element id portion of an element id pair.

id.description: Element id to convert into a component instance.

name.description: The name of the new component.

replace.description: Whether to replace the source element on the canvas with a new instance of the created component. Defaults to true.

transform_element_to_component.description: Transform an element into a component.

anyOf.description: Run transform_element_to_component: Transform an element into a component.

component.description: The component id portion of an element id pair.

element.description: The element id portion of an element id pair.

component_instance_id.description: Element id of the component instance to unlink.

scope_component_id.description: Optional id of the component definition the element lives inside. When set, the element lookup walks this component's tree instead of the page. When omitted, the page is searched first and then the component id portion of the element id is tried automatically.

unlink_component_instance.description: Unlink a component instance, converting it back into regular editable elements. Instances nested inside component definitions are supported. Cannot be used on library or code components.

anyOf.description: Run unlink_component_instance: Unlink a component instance, converting it back into regular editable elements. Instances nested inside component definitions are supported. Cannot be used on library or code components.

component_id.description: The id of the component to unregister.

unregister_component.description: Unregister a component. DANGEROUS ACTION — affects all existing instances.

anyOf.description: Run unregister_component: Unregister a component. DANGEROUS ACTION — affects all existing instances.

prop_id.description: The id of the prop to update.

group.description: New group, or null to clear.

tooltip.description: New tooltip, or null to clear.

clear_default_value.description: When true, clear the default value entirely. Cannot be combined with any default_* field — the two would silently fight, with the default_* value winning.

open_in_new_tab.description: Open the link in a new tab.

update_prop.description: Update one or more existing prop definitions on a component. Only the provided fields change; omitted fields stay the same.

anyOf.description: Run update_prop: Update one or more existing prop definitions on a component. Only the provided fields change; omitted fields stay the same.

actions.description: Actions to execute sequentially. Each array item must include label and exactly one action property: create_blank_component, create_prop, create_variant, delete_variant, duplicate_component, duplicate_variant, get_all_components, get_component, get_component_instance_props, get_parent_component, get_variant_settings, get_variant_styles, insert_component_instance, query_components, remove_prop, reorder_variants, reset_all_props_value, set_component_instance_prop_values, set_component_metadata, set_variant_name, set_variant_styles, transform_element_to_component, unlink_component_instance, unregister_component, update_prop.

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."
